data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Zayyana' which means 'pure, clean'. In Islamic tradition, Muzayyanah is a name given to a girl born in a pure, clean environment or raised with pure intentions. The name Muzayyanah carries the meaning “Pure, Clean” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muzayyanah usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, clean and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muzayyanah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
